_meta.source: Illustrative calibration diagnostic results. Based on typical backcast checks: generation by fuel, prices, capacity factors.
_meta.description: Example keeper-run scorecard comparing modeled vs measured results for ERCOT 2024. Mix of PASS/WARN/FAIL across metrics. Shows diagnostic structure for calibration validation.

checks.notes: Excellent: within rounding. CEMS monthly CFs applied per NUCLEAR_MONTHLY_CF_BY_YEAR.
Within tolerance. Slight model overshoot driven by committed floor slightly higher than observed. See commitment-screen tuning notes.
Model slightly underdispatches CC. Likely due to offer-curve econ_low multiplier (1.06); measured data suggests actual min-load cost ~1.04×. Minor tuning in next pass.
Model underdispatches CT peakers. Possible cause: ORDC curve not binding hard enough in scarcity hours. Check 2024 reserve margins in peak hours.
Excellent: wind CFs from EIA-930 NG:WND. No outliers.
Model slightly underdispatches solar. Likely curtailment mask too aggressive or HSL potential underestimated. Verify with HSL 2024 update.
Excellent: mean price within 1%. Suggests offer curves and fuel prices well-calibrated.
Model overshoots low prices. Likely coal must-run tranches running too cheap; coal take-or-pay sigmoid may need steepening. See detailed note in calibration log.
On target. Median (mid-merit hours) reflects balanced offer curves.
Model slightly underprices scarcity hours. Gas-CT dispatch slightly low (see gen_gas_ct WARN above). Trade-off acceptable.
Model runs coal 0.3 points of CF higher than measured. Consistent with gen_coal WARN. Investigate committed floor.
Model slightly conserves CC dispatch. Consistent with gen_gas_cc result.
Excellent: wind CF match within rounding.
Model slightly underdispatches solar (consistent with gen_solar WARN). Acceptable.

action_items.root_cause: Coal must-run tranches priced too low. Take-or-pay sigmoid may need steepening (midpoint gas price shift or increased steepness parameter).
action_items.fix: Increase COAL_TRANCHES sigmoid steepness from 0.8 to 0.95; retune committed floor share.

action_items.issue: Gas-CT underdispatches by 3.2%; ORDC scarcity penalty may be weak.
action_items.root_cause: Possible: (1) ORDC curve knees too far out in reserve space, or (2) reserve margin definition doesn't bind correctly in model.
action_items.fix: Review ORDC parameters against real ERCOT day-ahead offers. Verify reserve margin calculations in P0/P1/P2 solve.

action_items.root_cause: HSL curtailment mask or potential may be conservative.
action_items.fix: Refresh HSL 2024 dataset when available (EIA-930 Upload U8). Validate against CAISO/ERCOT measured curtailment rates.

keeper_decision.reasoning: Run42 is structurally sound: 77% of metrics pass, mean LMP and median prices on target, coal/wind/solar generation matched to within calibration tolerance. The P10 price overshoot and coal CF overshoot are both traceable to the same root cause (committed floor + must-run sigmoid), which is a tuning issue, not a structural flaw. The gas-CT undershoot is secondary and resolves once ORDC scarcity binding is tightened. No mechanism is inverted or missing. Run42 becomes the baseline for 2026–2030 runs until the noted action items are addressed in run43.
keeper_decision.notes: Certified for forward use. Backcast matches real market behavior within acceptable margins for a reduced-form LP model.
